A [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] '''guard''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] and worked for the Belugan leader, [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]], along with five other guards accompanied [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] at a meeting with a team of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] who were supposed to bring him his future wife, kidnapped [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]]. When the [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] which carried her arrived, only one bounty hunter was apparently left guarding her, former [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Ventress then told Blank that she would give him the cargo containing Pluma only after he had paid up. Moments later, this guard approached Ventress, giving her the credits and receiving the chest from her. After this guard partially opened the chest, the bounty hunter [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] kicked the lid up as far as it would go, revealing himself to have been locked in the chest, much to the surprise of the guards as well as the disgust of Otua Blank.<ref name="Bounty" />
